payments-mobile-collect-addresses.text: Learn how to collect customer addresses and phone numbers in your mobile app with the Address Element.
Autocomplete is enabled by default on iOS.
Only collect phone numbers if you need them for the transaction.

payments-mobile-collect-addresses.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/collect-addresses describes collecting physical addresses and phone numbers via the mobile Address Element (new raw lines 5-7). Its four links route readers to UIKit, SwiftUI, Android and React Native variants (new raw lines 13-16). The April 22, 2026 guide documents Stripe account and SDK setup with a client publishable key, UIKit optional delegate results, SwiftUI bound address state, Android onCreate registration and Succeeded/Canceled, and React Native AddressSheet onSubmit/onError dismissal. It documents default iOS autocomplete and Google Places dependency and key for Android autocomplete, including React Native Android (old raw lines 23-149, old raw lines 203-356, old raw lines 408-535 and old raw lines 603-719). Optionally passing populated shipping details to the payment UI can prefill billing and set PaymentIntent.shipping upon confirmation in the documented paths. PaymentMethod billing defaults use separate configuration, and address capture is independent of payment completion (old raw lines 140-184, old raw lines 526-583 and old raw lines 711-764). The prior source-stripe-inapp-collect-addresses.md preserved the four client integrations and overgeneralized address collection modes. The revised entry distinguishes those modes and supplies explicit OS and confirmation scope.
payments-mobile-collect-addresses.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/collect-addresses the four links are documentation navigation (new raw lines 9-16 compared with old raw lines 8-10, old raw lines 188-190, old raw lines 393-395 and old raw lines 588-590). The capture supplies no substantive change, renewed SDK minimum, or deprecation. The revised source-stripe-inapp-collect-addresses.md dates SDK compatibility, Android onCreate and React Native dismissal requirements, Android-only Google Places autocomplete setup, and the field-specific `Full` address example to April 22, 2026 (old raw lines 23-35, old raw lines 414-513, old raw lines 562-583 and old raw lines 644-709). Preserve the distinction between PaymentSheet `shippingDetails` and React Native `defaultShippingDetails`, and between confirmation-time PaymentIntent.shipping and attached PaymentMethod billing defaults (old raw lines 140-184, old raw lines 526-583 and old raw lines 711-764). The required-phone options in the April UIKit and React Native examples are configuration examples. The guide directs readers to collect phone numbers only when needed for the transaction (old raw lines 184-186, old raw lines 389-391, old raw lines 584-586 and old raw lines 766-768). The reciprocal overview should point to the available detailed guide and avoid making broad automatic integration or equal-feature language a mobile API instruction. The separate same-instance web Elements flow does not establish mobile behavior. Address entry, prefill and even a confirmation-time shipping field do not prove a completed charge.
